title: Addressing from Heavens
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
You only our Lord, You are our Creator! O the Lord of Heavens, the Lord of Creation! You are only One. We
are giving most high praising, most high glorifying to You, our Lord! O our Lord! Forgive us, and give Your
blessings for Your weak servants. And we are asking humbly to be much more glory, praising, and honor for
the most chosen one through Your Divinely Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Alfu salaat, alfu salaam to
be on him. O our Lord! We are weak servants; forgive us. And our salute and high greetings for our master,
master of this world. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
What do you think, `ulamas? How our Lord has one world, one dunya? Tawbah, astaghfirullah! What you are
saying, O Muslim `ulama, or from Christian learned people, and from Jewish brother rabbis? What is their
knowledge on that point? (Do you say) our Lord has only one dunya, one globe? What is that? And last night
we were saying something in our very, very simple association and we are not claiming that we are
something, no. Whole creation, their levels nothing; either everything or nothing! Everything for the Lord of
Heavens, the Lord of Creation, that running from pre-Eternal up to Eternal. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) That
is only for One, the Creator, Allah Almighty. Stand up! Give your high respect to your Creator! (Mawlana

Shaykh sits.)
Don't be heedless; don't say, “I am something.” O People, whom they are mostly cheated by imitated titles, do
not be cheated by imitated titles up to graveyard. May be your grave is in a common cemetery or may be
under Westminster Abbey or any other cathedral. They were thinking that they are something; something,
and now you are nothing! You are happy?
No one can say, “I am here,” when he is in a majesty king's presence, going like this, bowing. No, he can't say,
“I am here, I am something,” never accepting his majesty king or majesty queen. Say, “O your majesty, I am
nothing,” because that is high adab, manners, yes. How anyone can say in the Divine Presence, “I am
something”? Behind one, a zero going to be something, but he never losing his real position to be zero. He
knows that he is zero, but one making for him a value, taking that zero on one going to be 10, putting two
zeros behind one going to be 100, or putting three zeros behind one going to be one 1000. In such a way you
are not using, you are not losing your character to be zero. Don't forget that every time you are zero, but if
that One taking on right hand, giving (you) an honor. If taking, you are nothing. Therefore, something must
be there as nothing, from the Lord of Creation.
You can understand, O our listeners? I am an old person, but from my childhood I am looking for my mindly
production that was running through my heart's ability or capacity. The heart is sultan! The most important
organ in your body is your heart, but so many people saying, “No, most important is here.” (Mawlana points
to his head.) Look, tawbah, astaghfirullah, now 100 people saying, “More important this, not that.” Tawbah,
astaghfirullah!
I am asking from my listeners; we are apologizing from them, but I must speak because only heavenly lights
coming through my heart and I must speak. Don't say, “Shaykh is speaking, king is speaking, president of US
is speaking,” no. Who is there speaking, if speaking from tongue it is okay, but who is speaking through
hearts must be heavenly power supporting and giving authority for speaking. Also some speeches coming and
entering to hearts, some of them never; for some is a bullet (from heavens), but for some it is empty bullet;
real bullet touching and making what it has been ordered to make. Therefore, don't think that every speech
going to reach to your heart and making what the Lord of Heavens asking to be there. From east to west
thousands of people speaking every night. What they are saying is so much because it is to fill time. They are

appointed, they must speak even that let them say, dome dome dome dome, dome dome dome dome! Make
people to dance at least. Why speaking?
I was in India, and first night we were going to our flat and passing through a park. I was hearing whak,
whak, whak and I saying, what is happening? Looking on that trees hundreds of crows speaking. Who is
listening? No one listening, but they are speaking and coming to my heart, who is hearing from them?
Heedless people listening! Oh, nothing to do and he is obliged to hear like crows speaking on that tree;
everyone speaking, everyone whak, whak, whak. Who is speaking and who is listening? No one! Everyone
speaking and everyone listening! Everyone singing, but no one listening because that one also singing. Now
21st century top level of civilization making people like crows: everyone must speak. Everyone not listening to
anyone. Nothing you can do. Before time (in the past), authorized people whom granted to be sultan or to be
majesty king, they are only authority to address people, no anyone speaking to him. That is high adab, high
good manners. Now people, because it is time of democracy, (people have changed).
O Muslims! Now I am speaking to Muslim brothers. You are going to Hajj, day of Jumu'ah, Friday, when
imam getting up on minbar whole people beginning to speak or shout? (No,) whole listening and one
speaking; that showing Muslim `ulamas you must know this reality. How you are giving fatwa? How you
saying democracy? What saying chaos if in Ka`aba Mu`azhamah everyone is speaking (at the same time)?
What is going to be there? Crows! How it can be now `ulamas and Muslims saying, “We are doctors and

PhDs?” How you are preventing that system against heavenly order to have one imam? Where are you
Muslim kings, Muslim presidents, Muslim `ulamas? Why not saying? You are not learning anything when
you are going to holy land. Try to learn how must be Muslims!
When the Prophet (s) was giving khutbah, whole Sahabah hearing, "sami`na wa ata`na -We are hearing and
obeying.” That is Islam! Where is Turkish government or Iraqi or Iranian or Egyptian or Indian or Afghan or
Pakistani government? Who saying to you to make this (way of) everyone speaking, not to listen to another
one? Allah saying you must have one imam, the ameer al-mu'mineen (commander of the faithful) is one.
Shari'ah saying if two, one taking down the one. I am speaking Shari'ah (... audio cut...) my two legs through
my grave, but I must speak truth because Allah Almighty may ask on the Day of Judgment, Day of
Resurrection, “Why you are not declaring to My servants to know real Islam and My heavenly order?”

Where is the director of Azhar ash-Shareef, director in Damascus, director in Saudi government, Iran
government, or Turkey government? Why you are not keeping that order when they are going to be no
support from the heavens to them? Now eating each other because everyone saying, “I am number one.”
Don't be angry "First Lady" of any government, no, but that is a new fashion. People saying such a new title,
because people they like always to be known with a new title. If they can find another title for the president
they should take it. I may say that what is over the president's level, kingdom, republic, the feet of the
kingdom (are now) on (the) head, and whom the Prophet (s) saying, "When the Last Day coming and that
Judgment Day approaching, going whole world under the command of feet." They are putting their head
down and feet up.
O People! I am sorry to shout to people but I am speaking real ishaarah (spiritual “indication”). I don't think
from Muslim or Jewish rabbi can object on me, no, can't be. If they are bringing a proof or evidence, they
can't bring any evidence through whole historical period; they can't bring any evidence that heads going to be
on feet's place and feet going to be up, no.
As-salaamu `alaykum our listeners! I am nothing! I am not asking to be something, no. I am only asking that
my God, my Creator, accepting me as His weakest servant, to say, “O My servant, that is enough for Me.”
That is honor over every honor that Mankind making it. Mankind creating so many, all of them useless, never
giving any benefit. Therefore, we are saying, O people, don't be cheated by imitated titles! You have only one
title, to be servant of your Creator, the Lord of Heavens! Anything wrong on books given to learned people,
your holy books teaching people to climb and to be (authorities), instead of Lord of Heavens to be there as
written through Old Testament, New Testament or Psalms! But I am sorry for people from Muslim world are
not declaring real command of their Lord, to be under one command, command not to be like Pakistani crow,
whak, whak, whak. I am saying who is speaking, no one is listening to them. Twenty-four hours this TV that
belong to Shaytan making people to speak, one finishing and another coming.
(One says,) “O our brothers! I am so happy that I am here in your presence and I am presenting my nation
that ladies best time, and I am coming here to speak to your crowd to understand which level German on it.”
Another coming, “Good evening my listeners. As you heard same work, foreign officer not knowing foreign
minister, another foreign minister what you are saying just as my colleague saying. As he was saying I am

also greeting, that you are leaving me to address to such a special crowd. Crowding ones that your life like
jewels on the crown of a majestic king and I am also coming to supporting my colleagues. Saying that I am
also on same ideas, that he must do this and that. We must taking everything from left side to right side!”
Another one coming, “I am Russian foreign minister and I am coming to support my colleagues. What they
saying is true and most suitable for world. That honor must be granted to our worldwide empire.” Some
saying, “Where you are speaking? You have empire, or democracy?” Another saying, “Learn to speak, then
come and speak!” Another saying, “Yes we are with you this side.”
May Allah forgive us! Understanding? I am blaming our Christian brothers once, but I am blaming Muslim
brothers ten times more, because heavenly order is clear to them! How you can do? How you can act with
holy rules? Heavenly rules so clear! Your Shari'ah saying if two getting up to say, “I must be your imam,”
Shari'ah saying take one away.
O Muslims! I am nothing, but sometimes I can touch. People fearing from pig flu that is unseen virus and
people trembling. I am much more bigger than that virus. You are fearing from virus and not me! You must
fear from me more than pig flu! (Mawlana Shaykh laughs.) O People! This is a music, saying take the flags of
heavens up and put their imitated flags down! If not, that one may take heavenly revenge from you. Perhaps
through one night that fearful lions coming and entering your homes and at morning you should be taken to
cemetery.
As-salaamu `alaykum my listeners! Don't sleep, wake up! Nimrod was saying, “I am the Lord of earth and I
don't accept the Lord of Heavens. I am going to fight!” Allah Almighty sending on them, not sending a virus,
but sending mosquito armies and Nimrod's armies just covered their bodies with armor. Mosquitoes
beginning eating, eating and because they can't shoot arrow, they can't use their swords, they can't use their
fists, arm, and weapons! We are saying virus but they can't reach to mosquito. Mosquito entering and
beginning to eat (their flesh) and never remaining except their bones and falling. Fear from Allah! That was
for Nimrod and his armies. And Allah not going to use this method for His disobedient servants; He may
send much more powerful virus that touching and going away.
Just I heard from my master that happened once upon a time in Basra a plague. First day just passed away
70,000 people; second day 73,000 people dying; third day 75,000 people dying of plague, and it is written

through old history books that happened for Basra people. Fourth day histories saying none remaining in
Basra. In their homes no one living inside to open door to get outside, or no one from outside living to enter;
nothing. Plague leaving, bringing another pig flu, because Allah Almighty preventing, “Don't eat pigs because
their meat is not clean and may kill you.” They are not understanding. Now sending to them. Allah is never
passing away and He is from pre-Eternal up to Eternal.
O People! That is something that tonight we have been granted through my master, master of this world, for
awakening you, warning; he is warning! Who created chicken flu, now changing to pig flu, and it is not as
they are saying killing a little bit. Heavenly order coming to that virus and virus taking from the Lord of
Heavens and if holy command coming to kill, may kill. Who can stop it? Whom are fearing from flu, three
times ablution cleaning mouth, three times cleaning nose, taking away and no need to use injection. It is not
needed to make a piece of cloth to put there (mask).
O People! Thank you that so many people listening and hearing, but whom listening may be a handful people
and majority not hearing. May Allah forgive us, that not to come a (heavenly) order for the virus to infect on
the Children of Adam. Then (if going everywhere) after the whole world finished (maybe) you can't (even)
find anyone to bury people. Fear of the Lord makes people to be straight, not like this or like that. O leaders
of nations! Keep yourself from heavenly anger because heavenly anger coming first on the leaders of nations!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah.
O People! Try to believe in spirituality and leave to be atheists. Atheist people most lowest level that they will
be there. O People! Believe and give your highest respect to your Lord and to His most beloved servant,
Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! Yaa Rabbee, yaa Allah! Forgive us, O our Lord, forgive us! Send us someone who
would collect our separated brothers to come all together. O our Lord, forgive us, forgive us, forgive us! We
are only looking for Your forgiveness and blessing. Ameen. Salamun `alal mursaleen, wal hamdu lillahi
Rabbil `alameen.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
Dome dome dome dome 8x

Allah. Fatihah. (56 minutes) Allah, SubhanAllah ! As-salaamu `alaykum!
